description: arXiv:2608.14035v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent developments in large language models (LLMs) and tool-using agents encourage people to explore the potential of using agents in chip design. The core question is what kind of AI we really need in such a sophisticated industry. To this end, we bring the idea of modeling a chip-design superintelligence as an enormous \textit{AI-organization}.
author: Linyang Li
